87267: Mikoto Mikoshiba is one of Nozaki's assistants and Yuu Kashima's best friend and classmate. He has red hair and equally red eyes. Both of his ears appear to be pierced and he usually wears tiny red earrings on them.
87269: Umetarou is the high school student that is the object of Chiyo Sakura's affection. He is secretly a manga artist named Sakiko Yumeno, the creator of the shoujo manga "Let's Love~". This manga is published in the magazine called Monthly Shoujo Romance.
87271: The viewpoint character of the series, Sakura is a high school girl with a crush on Nozaki, but when her confession is misinterpreted, she ends up becoming Nozaki's inker assistant. She is in class 2-A and a member of the school's art club.
88114: The prince of the school, even though she is female. She is very popular among the female students and flirts with them. She is part of the drama club and is in class 2-G.
88115: Sakura's classmate. Easily makes people feel offended. She is a member of the choir club and her singing voice is beautiful enough to be referred to as "Lorelei".
88116: A third year student and the president of the drama club. He is good in acting and used to appear in plays but stopped due to his short height and now in charge of props. Kashima always causes him trouble but he is often like a doting parent to her.
88117: Freshman who belong to the basketball club and he knows Nozaki since middle school since they were in the same basketball club.
123189: Previous editor in charge for Nozaki. He is obsessed with tanukis. He likes to attend mixers, drink at parties and read gravure pages.
123191: Editor in charge for Nozaki. Unfriendly, but Nozaki sees him as cool adult. Ken's favorite foods are fried fish balls and alcohol, while his least favorite foods are sweet foods. His hobby is reading. His preferred type are sensible, responsible, and, self-reliant women.
123192: A college student and a shoujo mangaka and also Nozaki's neighbor who lives upstairs. Her type is people she can relax around.
127276: A character from the game Girls Princess, introduced by Mikoshiba to Nozaki. Tomoda is a supportive character to the protagonist of the game, going as far as to give his youth to the protagonist to assist him.
302694: The hero of Yumeno Sakiko’s manga “Let’s Love”. A gentleman who excels at everything.
310600: The heroine of Yumeno Sakiko’s manga “Let’s Love”. Her appearance is inspired by Sakura Chiyo and her personality is based on Mikoshiba Mikoto’s.
